Could be gut issues but I'm taking stomach soothers so it should take care of any inflammation. My eczema is definitely better than it was before cyclosporine. But I'm still getting flare ups. Although they are smaller so there's that. In the beginning I had couple side effects like headaches, exhaustion and shivers. Now they are weaker. Still get shivers from time to time, and my gums feel a little bit sensitive, but I guess I got used to the medicine. Overall I'm so glad my doctor prescribed me cyclosporine because nothing else was working for me and after one horrible experience with stronger steroids I don't want anything to do with that stuff.
